intro_text: You wake up inside a locked Victorian library. A heavy iron exit door blocks your way, secured by a 4-digit keypad. Around you are a wooden desk, an oak bookshelf, an oil painting, and a locked drawer.

desk.name: Wooden Desk
desk.description: A mahogany desk covered in scattered parchment. A brass magnifying glass rests near the inkwell, and a locked drawer is built into the front.

bookshelf.name: Oak Bookshelf
bookshelf.description: Three leather-bound books stand slightly pulled out. Inside their front covers are handwritten digits in red ink: 4, 1, and 9.

painting.name: Oil Painting
painting.description: An oil painting of a midnight clock tower. Without magnification, the corner inscription is too tiny to read clearly.
painting.magnified_description: Using the magnifying glass, you read the tiny carved inscription in the frame's corner: 'Hour VII' (7).

drawer.name: Locked Drawer
drawer.locked_description: A sturdy desk drawer secured with a 3-digit combination lock.
drawer.unlocked_description: The unlocked drawer holds a torn note reading: 'Append the painting's hour to the bookshelf digits to open the exit.'

door.name: Heavy Iron Exit Door
door.locked_description: A reinforced iron exit door with a 4-digit keypad.
door.unlocked_description: The heavy bolts retract and the exit door swings open to freedom!
